paite: Huan hiaite nung in hichi ahong hi a, Joseph kiangah, "Ngai in, na pa achi na,” achi uhi. Huchi in atapa nihte Manasseh leh Ephraim akiang ah atonpih hi.
heading: Jakob In Ephraim Leh Manasseh Avualzawl
english: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

paite: Jakob kiang ah, "Ngai in, na tapa Joseph na kiang ah ahong hi," chi in ahilh uh. Israel akihalhsak a, lupna ah atutou hi.
english: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

paite: Jakob in Joseph kiang ah, "Pathian Bangkim hihthei, Kanaan gam a Luz ah ka kiang ah akilak a, ahon vualzawl hi.
english: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

paite: Ka kiang ah, chi tampi ka hon suangsak ding a, ka hon hihpung lai ding. Chi tuamtuam omkhawm in ka hon bawl ding. Hiai gam na nung a na suante kiang ah atangtawn gou ding un ka pe ding," ahon chi hi.
english: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’

paite: "Na tapa nihte, Aigupta gam a na neihte, kei' a ahi ua, Reuben leh Simeon mah bang in Ephraim leh Manasseh kei' a ahi ding uhi.
english: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

paite: Hiai mite nung a ta na neihte nang a ahi ding uh, agoutan uah asanggamte uh min akikoppih ding uh ahi.
english: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

paite: Kei tungthu ahihleh, Padan gam a kipan ka hong pai lai in Kanaan gam ah lamkal ah Ephrath khua gamla kuam ahih lai in, ka kiang ah Rakil asi hi. Huai ah Ephrath kho lampi ah ka vuita, huai tuh Bethlehem khua ahi,” achi hi.
english: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”

paite: Israel in Joseph tapate a-en a, "Hiaite kuate ahi ua?" achi hi.
english: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”

paite: Joseph in apa kiang ah, "Hiaite ka tapa, Pathian in ahon piakte ahi uh," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hehpih in ka kiang ah hon pi in, amau ka na vualzawl ding," achi hi.
english: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”

paite: Israel mit a-upat tak ziak in achiim nawn kei a, ama'n ana tawp a, ana pom hi.
english: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

paite: Israel in Joseph kiang ah, "Na mel muh ka kilamen nawn kei a, himahleh, ngai in, Pathian in na suante mel nangawn ahon musakta," achi hi.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”

paite: Joseph in amau apa khuk kal a kipan apikhia a, amai a lei si in akun hi.
english: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

paite: Joseph in anih un akai a, Ephraim pen akhut taklam in Israel khut veilam pang ah, Manasseh pen akhut veilam in Israel khut taklam pang a kai in apinai hi.
english: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.

paite: Israel in asawkkalh teitei a, akhut taklam in asawk a, Ephraim anaupangzaw lusip ah anga a; Manasseh bel ata masa ahi.
english: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

paite: Joseph avualzawl a, "Hon suangpa Abraham leh Isak om zelna Pathian, tuni tan a ka damsung tengteng hon vakpa Pathian,
english: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,

paite: thil hoih lou tengteng a kipan hon tanpa Angel in naupangte vualzawl hen. Ka min leh hon suangpa Abraham leh Isak min pu uhen. Khovel ah thupitak hi ding in hong pung uhen,” achi hi.
english: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”

paite: Joseph in apa'n akhut taklam Ephraim lusip a angak amuh in alungkim kei hial a; apa khut Ephraim lusip a kipan Manasseh lusip a suan ding in apa khut suansak a sawm hi.
english: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

paite: Joseph in apa kiang ah, "Pa, hichibang ding ahi kei. Hiai ahi ta masa, na khut taklam a lusip ah nga zaw in," achi hi.
english: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”

paite: Himahleh, apa a-ut kei a, "Ka thei hi, ka tapa aw, ka thei hi. Amah leng nam gen tham in a-om ding a, amah leng athupi ding hi. Himahleh amah sang in anaupa athupizaw ding a, asuante leng chi tuamtuam tamtak ahong hi ding uh," achi hi.
english: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”

paite: Huchi in Jakob in, "Nang ah Israel vualzawl ahi ding, Pathian in Ephraim leh Manasseh bang in hon bawl hen," chi in avualzawl hi. Huchibang in Manasseh ma ah Ephraim a-omsak hi.
english: He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in your name, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.

paite: Israel mah in Joseph kiang ah, "Ngai in, si ding ka hita. Himahleh na kiang uah Pathian a-om ding a, nou hon suangtute gam ah ahon pilut nawn ding hi.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

paite: Huai lou leng, na sanggamte tantuan sang in tan khat ka hon pe tuan hi, ka namsau leh ka thalpeu a Amorte khut a kipan ka laksak pen," achi hi.
english: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”
